description: Device-specific quirks and edge cases from Home Assistant's Tuya integration
source: Various platform files with special handling and notes

category_duplicates.description: Device categories that are mapped to other categories
category_duplicates.notes: These are exact duplicates using LIGHTS['cz'] = LIGHTS['kg'] syntax

multi_entity_devices.description: Devices that create multiple entities with different DPCodes

dpcode_fallbacks.description: Multiple DPCodes tried in order for same functionality

examples.fsd_light_switch: Try SWITCH_LED first, then LIGHT as fallback

undocumented_categories.description: Device categories not found in official Tuya documentation

categories.mbd: VECINO RGBW light - found in diagnostics
categories.qjdcz: Unknown product with light/switch capabilities in diffusers, plugs, PIR flood lights
categories.hxd: Wake Up Light II - not documented
categories.dsd: Filament Light - mentioned in OEM docs but not in main documentation
categories.dghsxj: Smart Camera - Low power consumption camera
categories.qxj: SIREN with External Probe - undocumented category

brightness_scaling_quirks.description: Different brightness scaling ranges based on device type
brightness_scaling_quirks.detection_logic: Must check device capabilities JSON for actual min/max values

color_data_versions.description: Different color data formats and their usage

versions.colour_data: Original format with 255 max for saturation/value
versions.colour_data_v2: Newer format with 1000 max for saturation/value
versions.colour_data_hsv: HSV format used by some devices like humidifiers

special_instruction_values.description: Non-standard instruction values for specific devices

climate_mode_mapping.description: Tuya HVAC modes mapped to Home Assistant modes

device_specific_notes.dj: Some RGB lights also provide switch capability for plugs
device_specific_notes.fsd: Ceiling fan lights may use either SWITCH_LED or LIGHT
device_specific_notes.kg: Switch category covers both switches and sockets
device_specific_notes.sp: Smart cameras have complex multi-entity configurations
device_specific_notes.cl: Curtains support multiple controllers and different instruction formats

entity_category_usage.description: When entities are marked as CONFIG vs normal entities

multi_entity_pattern_recognition.description: Advanced multi-entity patterns identified from analysis data

dps_patterns.description: Systematic DPS usage in 100+ range for energy monitoring

multi_phase_patterns.example: DPS 103/104/105 for Phase A, DPS 113/114/115 for Phase B

dps_patterns.description: Complex devices with primary controls and configuration entities
Advanced lighting with DPS 20-26 range patterns
Climate devices with binary sensor monitoring

detection_algorithm.step_2: Look for corresponding timer DPS in range 9-14
detection_algorithm.step_3: Check for config DPS in range 38-43

raw_decoding.note: Some devices provide raw electrical data that needs struct unpacking
raw_decoding.voltage_scale: Raw bytes 0-2, big-endian uint16, divide by 10
raw_decoding.current_scale: Raw bytes 2-5, big-endian uint24, divide by 1000
raw_decoding.power_scale: Raw bytes 5-8, big-endian uint24, divide by 1000

dptype_correction.description: Cloud sometimes provides ill-formed DPTypes that need correction

discovery_search_order.description: Order of searching for DPCodes in device data
discovery_search_order.note: status is only searched when not looking for specific datatype
